authFailed: Acorny: export token rejected — update it in Settings.
indexError: Acorny: sync stopped — the synced-document index looks incomplete, so syncing was aborted to avoid creating duplicate documents. ${reason}
setTokenFirst: Acorny: set your export token in Settings first.
selectNotebookFirst: Acorny: choose a target notebook in Settings first.
settingFolder: Document folder (path within notebook) — existing documents are moved here when you save
movedDocs: Acorny: moved ${count} document(s) into the new folder.
unexpectedError: Acorny: sync failed unexpectedly — see the developer console for details.
confirmDestinationFirst: Acorny: settings saved. Check the target notebook and folder, then press “Sync now” once — automatic syncing starts only after you have run it yourself.
